description: The University of Khartoum Materials and Structures Testing Laboratory produced tensile test reports for steel reinforcing bars used in Sudanese construction projects. Researchers transcribed 12,161 individual bar tests from 3,898 reports dated 2016–2022 into this Mendeley Data workbook. Eight data sheets separate nominal diameters from 8 to 32 millimetres; documentation sheets explain column names and units. The article lists measured effective diameter, cross-sectional area, weight, yield and ultimate strength, elongation, cold-bending result and test date. The repository lists one public XLSX under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is bars submitted to one testing laboratory from multiple Sudanese projects, not a probability sample of all steel in service or structural failures. Report selection, original test conditions and transcription from paper certificates limit population-level inference, although the article describes double-entry and spot checks. A reviewer-assessed use is assigning material-property ranges to structural response simulations. model-opensees is a related structural simulator, but no material model was fitted or checked here. The workbook was not downloaded; its sheet contents were taken from the article and its public file name from Mendeley metadata.
